parameterization.prior_run_reference: seed 64920 RUN1 (task B649_K20_FILMUS_WARD_NONOBLIVIOUS_R1) is a separate, already-judged trajectory; no result-dependent values from it are imported here beyond the shared incumbent identity and frozen method authority

scientific_question: Whether this single frozen seed-64921 trajectory (an independent preregistered replication of the already-judged seed-64920 Filmus-Ward method using a different seed) encounters a K20 portfolio whose canonical OFFICIAL_ANY_PRIZE exact count strictly exceeds the pinned champion.

scope.portfolio_invariants: exactly 20 unique legal tickets; canonicalize by sorting values within tickets and sorting tickets lexicographically
scope.initial_search_state: X = C = the independently verified pinned champion
scope.move: replace exactly one ticket t in frozen X with one legal six-number ticket u not already in X; this may change one through six numbers in t

mathematics.official_outcome_reduction: For outcome (D,s), W = D union {s}; a ticket wins OFFICIAL_ANY_PRIZE iff its intersection with W has size at least 3. Every 7-number W corresponds to exactly seven official B649 outcomes.
mathematics.coverage_multiplicity: c_P(W) is the number of tickets in P with at least three values in W.
mathematics.search_potential: G(P) = 7 * sum_W h_{c_P(W)} with curvature parameter 1; h_0 = 0 and h_m = integral_0^1 (e^p/(e-1)) * (1-(1-p)^m)/p dp.
mathematics.marginal_histogram: For R = X without t, H_(R,v)(r) counts 7-sets W for which v intersects W in at least 3 values and c_R(W)=r. The exact move difference is 7 * sum_(r=0..19) [H_(R,u)(r)-H_(R,t)(r)] * (h_(r+1)-h_r).
mathematics.marginal_enumeration: Enumerate each measured ticket's winning W once using j=3..6 ticket values and 7-j complement values; expected production count is 2,658,776 per marginal; process chunks no larger than 65,536.
mathematics.potential_coefficients: b_0=1; b_r=r*b_(r-1)+1; h_(r+1)-h_r=(r!*e-b_r)/(e-1). Each potential difference is (A*e-B)/(e-1), with arbitrary-precision integer A and B recorded as decimal strings.
mathematics.certified_e_bounds: L_n=sum_(j=0..n)1/j! and L_n < e < L_n+1/(n*n!). Compare using exact rational arithmetic at n=64, then n=128 if unresolved. Equality is exact only when A=0 and B=0. Unresolved at n=128 makes RUN1 BOUNDED_INCOMPLETE.
mathematics.bonferroni_role: SAFE_EXACT_SCORE_FILTER_ONLY; recompute full_u3_components from scratch for every unique legal proposal, and do not use the two-changed-ticket incremental helper. U3 <= F(C) excludes exact champion scoring only; neither branch suppresses marginal potential evaluation or movement.

rng_and_proposals.round_batch: freeze X and generate all 32 raw proposals in raw-slot order before evaluation
rng_and_proposals.slots_0_15: choose ticket index with rng.randrange(20) over canonical X; rng.sample one value from the selected ticket's ascending values; then rng.sample one value from its ascending complement; removal sample precedes addition sample
rng_and_proposals.slots_16_23: choose ticket index with rng.randrange(20); sample two removals from the ascending ticket values, then two additions from the ascending complement
rng_and_proposals.slots_24_31: choose ticket index with rng.randrange(20); sample a new ticket of six from ascending 1..49
rng_and_proposals.slot_semantics: normalize every proposal; no-op, duplicate ticket, and repeated candidate consume the slot and are never redrawn; earliest raw occurrence owns a repeated candidate
rng_and_proposals.trace: preserve RNG pre/post states, raw proposal and normalized candidate identity

selection_and_champion.candidate_order: evaluate each distinct legal candidate in raw-slot order, including its U3 screen/exact requirement and its certified potential
selection_and_champion.search_move: after the complete batch, choose the candidate with greatest strictly positive potential difference; potential decreases and exact-objective decreases are allowed only when the potential strictly improves
selection_and_champion.champion_rule: C changes only after canonical OFFICIAL_ANY_PRIZE exact scoring proves a strict integer-count increase; equal count retains existing C; update C independently while evaluating proposals and do not reset X to C
selection_and_champion.score_delta_consistency: F(X')-F(X)=7*[H_(R,u)(0)-H_(R,t)(0)] is a consistency check only and never substitutes for canonical exact champion scoring

exact_score_triggers: pinned incumbent loader performs one canonical exact champion recomputation and its distinct exact bound fixtures; count every scorer call against the canonical exact-call budget
every unique legal proposal with U3 > F(C)
selected search move if it has not already received canonical exact scoring
final archived champion recomputed without trusting caches

normal: a fully evaluated batch has no strict potential improvement

claims.positive_final_decision: STRICT_IMPROVEMENT_FOUND only when exact champion count > 312867226
claims.complete_negative_final_decision: DIRECT_OBJECTIVE_BOUNDED_NEGATIVE only after legitimate completion without an exact champion improvement; limited to seed 64921, frozen proposal policy, observed trajectory and budgets

practical_lift_threshold.classification_rule: PRACTICAL_LIFT_THRESHOLD_MET = YES iff FINAL_CHAMPION_OUTCOME_COUNT >= 312873246, else NO; a smaller strict positive delta is still a real improvement and must not be rounded to zero, and meeting/missing this threshold does not by itself authorize any further geometry experiment
